import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static int yearUniversityAdmission(int n, List<Integer> array) {
        int sum = 0;
        for (int x : array) {
            sum += x;
        }
        return sum / n;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        List<Integer> years = new ArrayList<>(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            years.add(scanner.nextInt());
        }
        System.out.println(yearUniversityAdmission(n, years));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
